caveats: Sea cells (3311 of 3600 grid cells) are those with finite SST on every target day; land/ice-masked cells carry mhw=0. Baseline pools additionally use the 5 days beyond the baseline period on each side (1991-12-27..31 and 2003-01-01..05) exactly as the prescribed +/-5-day windows require. Thresholds and climatology were derived from the same reprocessed L4 product as the target period.
